groups.sub: Iota Temple, Ogal Cluster, Korm's Belt, Bendar Cluster
conditions: A Point of Interest has a yellow marker. The white markers Piloting rank 5 reveals are derelicts and never drop Oberon.
Sover Strait never spawns a Point of Interest.
Drop chance boosters don't affect cache rolls.
bonuses: Railjack salvage pays Endo, so the time isn't wasted.

disclosures.title: running it efficiently
disclosures.body: One player boards the outpost while the rest of the squad or the AI gunners kill fighters. Tactical Intrinsic rank 4 (Recall Warp) lets the Omni teleport you back to the Railjack after the cache. AI crew is unreliable at shooting outpost radiators, so a solo player can stall on some Points of Interest. Bad luck can run to ~65 caches per part.

disclosures.title: Eximus drops
disclosures.body: Overframe lists every part at 0.39% (Systems 0.23%) from Eximus enemies. That is incidental, not a farm.

groups.activity: Skirmish, two Point of Interest objectives
conditions: Clear both yellow objectives before killing the last fighters and crewships, or the mission ends before you roll the cache.

disclosures.title: the Circuit route
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, Oberon is week 5 of the 11-week Normal Circuit, shared with Nekros and Valkyr. Neuroptics at tier 2, Chassis at 5, Systems at 8 and the main blueprint at 10, so no Market purchase. One frame per week; the choice resets Monday 00:00 UTC, and picking someone else means waiting a full rotation.
